Sure! To submit a vote on VirusTotal for the IP address **22.242.75.136** using your API key (`key_four`), you’ll need to make a POST request to the VirusTotal voting endpoint. Below are two common ways to do this: via **curl** (command line) and via **Python** (using `requests`).  

> **⚠️ Important** – Make sure you keep your API key secret. Never share it publicly or commit it to version control.

---

## 1. Using `curl`

```bash
curl -X POST \
     -H "x-apikey: <YOUR_KEY_FOUR>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}' \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes"
```

Replace `<YOUR_KEY_FOUR>` with the actual value of your `key_four`.  
If the request succeeds, you’ll receive a JSON response confirming the vote was recorded.

---

## 2. Using Python (`requests`)

```python
import requests
import json

API_KEY = "<YOUR_KEY_FOUR>"
IP_ADDRESS = "22.242.75.136"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{IP_ADDRESS}/votes"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": API_KEY,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}

payload = {
    "type": "vote",
    "attributes": {
        "verdict": "malicious"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(payload))

print("Status Code:", response.status_code)
print("Response Body:", response.json())
```

Again, replace `<YOUR_KEY_FOUR>` with your actual key.  
A status code of **200** (or **201**) indicates success; any other code will contain error details.

---

| ✅ | Use HTTPS (`https://`) |
| ✅ | Set `Content-Type: application/json` |
| ✅ | Include the JSON payload exactly as shown |
